proposed_widenings.name: hazard_zone
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier creates a persistent area that fires a DEX save gate every time any creature enters the zone or ends its turn there, for the full concentration duration. No existing family models repeated-event-triggered save gates over a duration. 'activation' fires phases once at cast; 'ongoing_effect' models persistent modifiers on already-attached targets; 'anchored_trigger' models a one-time release (Alarm). A new 'hazard_zone' family is needed for spells that create a persistent dangerous area with event-driven per-creature resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the wall's space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall's space or ends its turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor — wall (straight and ring)
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier creates a wall: either straight (length × height × thickness) or ringed (diameter × height × thickness). Neither is representable with existing AreaShapeDescriptor variants. 'line' is 2D with no height field. A wall is a vertical planar structure with three independent dimensions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick.

proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier makes its space Difficult Terrain for the concentration duration. No current EffectAtom covers terrain modification. TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §12 notes 'difficult_terrain (2 hits)' as survey pressure not yet promoted to v4.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_cover
proposed_widenings.justification: The wall grants Three-Quarters Cover, which modifies incoming attack rolls and DEX saves for creatures behind it. Cover as a mechanically modeled effect is absent from v4 EffectAtom.

notes: The fundamental blocker is structural: Blade Barrier is a persistent hazard zone with repeated event-driven saves (on-enter and on-end-turn), not a one-shot activation or a simple ongoing buff. No existing SpellMechanics family encodes this honestly. The wall geometry and difficult_terrain are secondary gaps that would also need addressing, but even with those resolved, the per-creature repeated-trigger save architecture requires a new family. No Dhall/JSON authored.
